name: Alchemy
title: Alchemy is not a confirmed item-crafting profession
summary: No separate alchemy profession is confirmed in the current item-crafting scope. Item Creation and Enchanting are the two confirmed item-crafting professions. Existing Magic questions in 99 concern mystical power, not recipes; any distinct alchemy system needs its own approval.
scenarioNote: Сценария нет, потому что системы в источниках нет.

points.text: Only Item Creation and Enchanting are confirmed item-crafting professions.
The Magic questions in 99 do not establish alchemy recipes or a profession.

gaps: No approved alchemy profession, recipes, quality rules, or risk model are documented; whether any separate system exists remains open.
